orbit join: responder app1; UE pools 2001:db8:a::/48 via 2001:db8:6::1, N6 2001:db8:6::/64
orbit join: N6 IP 2001:db8:6::20 on ens5 (from the route to the UPF's N6 address 2001:db8:6::1; override with --n6-ip)
orbit join: control bind [2001:db8:c::20]:9551 on ens4 (from the route to the server at 2001:db8:c::10; override with --bind)

Plan:
  1. install the verified orbit as /usr/local/lib/orbit/orbit (sha256 5727cc2e9e9c9684cd04fb9ae3f255c8ee380752ac82c8e0a65fd9d307c991f6)
  2. route UE pool 2001:db8:a::/48 back through the UPF
       ip -6 route replace '2001:db8:a::/48' via '2001:db8:6::1' dev 'ens5'
  3. firewall: allow control traffic (tcp) on ens4 from 2001:db8:c::10/128 to port 9551
       nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens4" ip6 saddr 2001:db8:c::10/128 tcp dport 9551 accept comment "orbit-join control ens4 2001:db8:c::10/128 9551"'
       inserted into inet filter input (your ruleset)
  4. firewall: allow data traffic (tcp, udp) on ens5 from 2001:db8:a::/48 to ports 32768-60999
       nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens5" ip6 saddr 2001:db8:a::/48 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 32768-60999 accept comment "orbit-join data ens5 2001:db8:a::/48 32768-60999"'
       inserted into inet filter input (your ruleset)
       (data ports 32768-60999: this host's ephemeral range (net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range), since the responder's receivers bind ephemeral ports)
  5. firewall: allow data traffic (tcp, udp) on ens5 from 2001:db8:6::/64 to ports 32768-60999
       nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens5" ip6 saddr 2001:db8:6::/64 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 32768-60999 accept comment "orbit-join data ens5 2001:db8:6::/64 32768-60999"'
       inserted into inet filter input (your ruleset)
       (data ports 32768-60999: this host's ephemeral range (net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range), since the responder's receivers bind ephemeral ports)
  6. create the system user orbit, which the responder runs as
       useradd --system --user-group --no-create-home --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin orbit
  7. install /usr/local/lib/orbit/join-net.sh (run as root before the responder starts):
       | #!/bin/sh
       | # orbit join: re-applies the N6 route and firewall rules for orbit-responder.service.
       | set -eu
       | PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
       | ip -6 route replace '2001:db8:a::/48' via '2001:db8:6::1' dev 'ens5'
       | nft list chain 'inet' 'filter' 'input' | grep -qF 'comment "orbit-join control ens4 2001:db8:c::10/128 9551"' || nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens4" ip6 saddr 2001:db8:c::10/128 tcp dport 9551 accept comment "orbit-join control ens4 2001:db8:c::10/128 9551"'
       | nft list chain 'inet' 'filter' 'input' | grep -qF 'comment "orbit-join data ens5 2001:db8:a::/48 32768-60999"' || nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens5" ip6 saddr 2001:db8:a::/48 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 32768-60999 accept comment "orbit-join data ens5 2001:db8:a::/48 32768-60999"'
       | nft list chain 'inet' 'filter' 'input' | grep -qF 'comment "orbit-join data ens5 2001:db8:6::/64 32768-60999"' || nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens5" ip6 saddr 2001:db8:6::/64 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 32768-60999 accept comment "orbit-join data ens5 2001:db8:6::/64 32768-60999"'
  8. install /etc/systemd/system/orbit-responder.service (not enabled or started):
       | [Unit]
       | Description=orbit N6 responder (orbit join)
       | Wants=network-online.target
       | After=network-online.target nftables.service iptables.service ip6tables.service netfilter-persistent.service
       | 
       | [Service]
       | User=orbit
       | Group=orbit
       | ExecStartPre=+/usr/local/lib/orbit/join-net.sh
       | ExecStart=/usr/local/lib/orbit/orbit responder --bind [2001:db8:c::20]:9551
       | Restart=on-failure
       | NoNewPrivileges=yes
       | ProtectSystem=strict
       | ProtectHome=yes
       | PrivateTmp=yes
       | CapabilityBoundingSet=
       | RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX
       | 
       | [Install]
       | WantedBy=multi-user.target
